authorization.scope: open experiment version 2.1.0; freeze statistical OPE thresholds before new seeds

statistical_ope_thresholds.derivation: Uniform logging over 3 B0 actions gives IPS weights in {0, 3}. Kish ESS equals the number of logged target matches, so E[ESS]=n/3. essMin is half of that expectation. maxWeight must equal 1/p=3. DR is exact because Q is the simulator. Coverage is one overall Wald 95% interval against online truth, not 7-world hit rate. SWITCH tau=10 is a conventional weight cap; with maxWeight=3 SWITCH equals IPS.
